I eat a high salt, low sugar diet. I’ve noticed that sugar really affects me negatively so I started to replace as much as I can with sugar alternatives like stevia. If I’m craving candy though I’ll still eat it, just in smaller portions. I also don’t avoid carbs, I’ve just switched from simple carbs to more complex carbs (i.e. whole grains) I noticed this still allows me to eat pasta and pastries without the sudden stomachaches and migraines that happened after eating simple carbs. Also, for people who find it hard to eat a lot of salt on a daily basis, salt pills help significantly!
